subject: Confirm that you want to delete your account
heading: Delete your account?
body: Hi {name}, we received a request to delete your {appName} account. Nothing is deleted until you open the link below and confirm.
consequences: Deleting the account signs you out everywhere and removes your profile, your sign-in methods, your course progress and your licence, whose key then stops working. Your orders are kept as payment records, no longer linked to you, as our Privacy Policy describes.
expiry: The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, and only while you are signed in.
fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
footer: If you did not ask to delete your account, ignore this email and change your password: your account stays as it is.
